family: Jolánka Hungarian postcards; sign classes as in hcp-1216/SOLUTION.md

signs.d: long stroke + short tick, either joined as a peak or crossing (h-like 4)
signs.g: hooked S with descender (large S in boldo|gok row 22, large double-looped form in dragam row 16)
signs.h: tall stroke + short tick at upper right = h or p
signs.i: crossed loop with dot, dot often omitted
signs.k: section-mark S (also a closed 8 in megkaptam)
signs.l: wave, sometimes a plain chevron without hook
signs.o: cursive loop (dots/tick for ö, ő, ó)
